final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total FROM city_counts) SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, 1.0 * c.address_count / t.total FROM city_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (1.0 * c.address_count / t.total) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
